issues.description: The problem statement explicitly instructs that the Lecture constructor parameters must follow the UML attribute order: (lectureName, numberOfInscribedStudents, numberOfGuestStudents, numberOfLecturers, numberOfTutors). However, the solution implements the constructor with a different parameter order: (lectureName, numberOfLecturers, numberOfTutors, numberOfInscribedStudents, numberOfGuestStudents). This inconsistency can confuse students and can cause automated tests to fail if they instantiate Lecture using the documented/UML order.
issues.suggestedFix: Adjust the solution constructor signature (and keep assignments consistent) to match the UML/problem statement order: public Lecture(String lectureName, int numberOfInscribedStudents, int numberOfGuestStudents, int numberOfLecturers, int numberOfTutors).
